title: 描述绘画结果
summary: 若干半开线段涂有互不相同的颜色值，重叠处颜色值相加，返回每段非空区间及其混合颜色和。
insight: 在线段起点给颜色和加值、终点减值，用有序映射保存差分。按坐标扫描时，前一坐标到当前坐标的活动颜色和固定，若非零就输出。
pitfalls: 混合颜色和可能超过 int

solutions.title: 有序坐标差分
solutions.idea: 只扫描所有端点并输出相邻端点间的活动颜色和。
steps: 按坐标递增，先用当前 active 输出 [previous,position)
再应用当前位置 delta 并更新 previous

code.java: class Solution { public List<List<Long>> splitPainting(int[][] segments){TreeMap<Integer,Long> difference=new TreeMap<>();for(int[] segment:segments){difference.merge(segment[0],(long)segment[2],Long::sum);difference.merge(segment[1],-(long)segment[2],Long::sum);}List<List<Long>> answer=new ArrayList<>();long active=0;int previous=0;boolean started=false;for(Map.Entry<Integer,Long> entry:difference.entrySet()){int position=entry.getKey();if(started&&active!=0&&previous<position)answer.add(Arrays.asList((long)previous,(long)position,active));active+=entry.getValue();previous=position;started=true;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun splitPainting(segments:Array<IntArray>):List<List<Long>>{val difference=java.util.TreeMap<Int,Long>();for(segment in segments){difference[segment[0]]=(difference[segment[0]]?:0)+segment[2];difference[segment[1]]=(difference[segment[1]]?:0)-segment[2]};val answer=mutableListOf<List<Long>>();var active=0L;var previous=0;var started=false;for((position,delta) in difference){if(started&&active!=0L&&previous<position)answer.add(listOf(previous.toLong(),position.toLong(),active));active+=delta;previous=position;started=true};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<vector<long long>> splitPainting(vector<vector<int>>& segments){map<int,long long> difference;for(auto& segment:segments){difference[segment[0]]+=segment[2];difference[segment[1]]-=segment[2];}vector<vector<long long>> answer;long long active=0;int previous=0;bool started=false;for(auto [position,delta]:difference){if(started&&active&&previous<position)answer.push_back({previous,position,active});active+=delta;previous=position;started=true;}return answer;} };
